# Stanford Medicine Children's Health

> Comprehensive pediatric and obstetric healthcare network serving the Bay Area through Lucile Packard Children's Hospital and specialty centers for cardiology, oncology, neurology, transplantation, and more.

Stanford Medicine Children's Health operates 60+ locations across the Bay Area, offering specialized pediatric care through dedicated centers like the Betty Irene Moore Children's Heart Center and Bass Childhood Cancer Center. The organization combines clinical excellence with innovative research programs including virtual reality applications for patient care.

## Key Topics

- Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford
- Pediatric cardiology
- Cancer treatment
- Transplant services
- Specialty centers
- Bay Area locations
- Telemedicine
- Clinical trials
- Pediatric surgery
- Neonatal care
- MyChart patient portal
- Virtual reality in medicine
- Orthopedic care
- Neurology and neurosurgery
- Primary care pediatrics

## Core Services & Locations

- [Stanford Medicine Children's Health](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en.html): Homepage for Stanford Medicine Children's Health pediatric and obstetric network
- [Medical Services Directory](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services.html): Directory of 65+ medical service locations and specialty centers
- [Specialty Services](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/specialty-centers.html): Comprehensive specialty care services directory for children
- [Locations & Directions](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/locations-directions.html): Facility locator for 60+ Bay Area locations and directions
- [Find a Doctor](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/find-a-doctor.html): Provider search and directory for Stanford Medicine Children's Health

## Specialty Centers & Clinical Programs

- [Betty Irene Moore Children's Heart Center](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/heart-center.html): Betty Irene Moore Children's Heart Center for pediatric cardiac care
- [Bass Childhood Cancer Center](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/cancer-blood-diseases.html): Bass Childhood Cancer Center for pediatric oncology and blood disorders
- [Pediatric Transplant Center](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/transplant.html): Pediatric Transplant Center for kidney, liver, heart, lung transplants
- [Brain and Behavior Center](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/brain-and-behavior.html): Brain and Behavior Center for pediatric neurology and neurosurgery
- [Children's Orthopedic and Sports Medicine Center](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/orthopedic.html): Orthopedic and sports medicine center for young athletes in Bay Area
- [Pregnancy and Newborn Services](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/pregnancy-newborn.html): Johnson Center for obstetric, neonatal, and developmental medicine
- [Center for IBD and Celiac Disease](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/ibd-celiac-center.html): Center for IBD and celiac disease in children and young adults
- [General Pediatrics](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/services/pediatrics-general.html): General pediatrics and primary care services across Bay Area

## Research & Innovation

- [Research and Innovation](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/research-innovation.html): Research and innovation programs at Lucile Packard Children's Hospital
- [Virtual Reality and Immersive Technologies](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/research-innovation/virtual-reality.html): VR and AR technologies for patient care and medical education
- [The Stanford Virtual Heart](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/research-innovation/virtual-reality/stanford-virtual-heart.html): Stanford Virtual Heart VR technology for congenital heart defects

## Patient Services & Support

- [Second Opinion Telemedicine Service](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/en/landing/second-opinion.html): Telemedicine second opinion service for pediatric specialist consultation
- [Spanish Language Services](https://www.stanfordchildrens.org/es.html): Spanish-language homepage for Stanford Medicine Children's Health
